rounds.response:
Checkout flow: Single-page checkout loads and completes end-to-end for guest and logged-in users; saved-address auto-suggest appears for logged-in users and selecting a suggestion autofills the address form; feature flag toggles between existing and new flow; submitting creates an order record and navigates to confirmation showing order ID.  
Payments: Only credit/debit card option is available; card data is tokenized via existing card-processor endpoint and successful tokenization leads to authorization and order placement; payment declines/errors follow the documented retry/decline flow.  
Shipping & pricing: After ZIP/postcode entry call the shipping-rate API and display shipping cost + delivery estimate prior to submission; taxes, discounts, and shipping recalc immediately on relevant input changes; order summary totals must match recalculated values.  
UI & errors: Client-side field validation shows the specified inline error copy for each field failure; show a generic top-of-page error banner only for system-level failures; order summary is sticky on desktop and collapsible on mobile.  
Performance & telemetry: First-interactive <2.5s on 3G and all third-party scripts load async; emit telemetry for funnel events (view, address entered, shipping selected, payment submitted, order confirmed) and log error types plus validation failure rates; release behind a feature flag at 10% and only ramp to 100% if error/abandonment rates remain within current baseline.
